utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Vik, I’m a bit slammed, but I’m trying to help with the repair drive—what’s the quick thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Bo — quick ask is just spread the word that we’re collecting small appliances, bikes, clothing, and simple electronics, and remind folks I’ll share the confirmed time and place once Hana locks it in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I’ll pass that along to the handy folks and keep it vague on time/place until Hana confirms.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye, thanks for helping pin this down — can you send me the exact drop-off table and tool station locations for Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Rosa — I know the repair drive is starting around 3:30 after pickup, but I’m still confirming the exact drop-off table and tool station spots. I’ll send them along as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — that works for now. I’ll keep the plan flexible and update neighbors once you confirm the exact spots.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m planning to start around 3:30, and I’ll bring duct tape, a flashlight, and spare screws if I can find them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Oren — I’ll be there around 3:30 with my drill and hammer, and I can help sort electronics when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be great, Sam—thank you. I’ll try to remember the duct tape and flashlight, and I’ll check my junk drawer for those screws before 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, we’re getting the repair drive pieces lined up—small appliances, bikes, clothing, and simple electronics for now. I’m just waiting on Hana to confirm the date and location before we spread those details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—thanks, Jules. I’ll hold off sharing anything until Hana confirms the date and location, and I can help with the drop-off table around 3:30 if that’s still the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — that would be great. I’ll pencil you in for the drop-off table around 3:30 and let you know as soon as Hana locks in the date and location.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Ira — for the repair drive, Noah’s sorting donated tools, and Bo and Rey are helping greet folks, so could you lend a hand with table setup around 9?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, Mara — I can be there around 9 to help set up tables, and I’ll keep noting any repair needs or spare parts I hear about while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — I’ll count on you for table setup around 9, and those notes on repair needs and spare parts will really help us stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—porch lights and loose handrails seem to be the big needs so far. Want me to add you to the invite list or pass along details once they’re firm?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Pass along the firm details, please. If you can note who needs porch lights versus handrails, that’ll help us line up supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Leo — I’ll send you the firm details once they’re set, and I’ll keep porch lights and handrails sorted separately so supplies go where they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going, and where can I jump in?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still checking the details with Rosa before I say too much, Dane, but if you’ve got spare screws, hinges, or a work lamp, please set them aside and I’ll tell you where to bring them once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’ll set aside any spare screws, hinges, and a work lamp I can find, and I’ll wait for your update on where to bring them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Nell, I’m piecing together the repair drive details now—Oren says he’ll start around 3:30 and bring duct tape, maybe a flashlight, and screws if he finds them. Have you heard anything firm I should pass along?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — the firmest things I’ve heard are porch lights and loose handrails as priorities, with Opal tentatively tracking bulbs and extension cords. Vik said he’ll help spread the word too, and I’m still passing along any carry-help requests as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Nell, I’ll pass along that porch lights and loose handrails are the priorities, with Opal on bulbs and cords and Vik helping spread the word. Send me any carry-help requests you hear, and I’ll keep the little grapevine moving.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, do you know anyone with tools who can commit, and have you heard of any specific repairs we should add to the list?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sam’s committed to bringing a drill and hammer, and I’ve asked Uli about spare screws, hinges, or a work lamp. So far I don’t have specific repairs confirmed, but I’m keeping a list as folks report them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, put Sam down as confirmed and tell me as soon as Uli answers. I still need actual repair names and items, not maybes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hi Hana, I’m still waiting on the firm schedule from Tess, but I’m keeping a neat list of anyone who needs repair help. If you hear of someone, send me their name and I’ll add it before my morning walk.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — I’ll send you names only once I’ve checked what repair they need and the best contact for them. Since Tess hasn’t confirmed the schedule yet, can you mark the list as tentative for now?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely — I’ll mark it tentative for now and keep the list organized until Tess confirms the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo—I’ll look for batteries first and bring any screws I can find too. If I spot extra tape or a flashlight, I’ll tuck those in as backup.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s perfect, Rey—batteries and screws are the main gap, and any backup tape or flashlight will be a big help too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, I’ll set those aside tonight and let you know what I actually find so your supply list stays accurate.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Kira — I’m tracking repair drive details now, but I’m still waiting on Faye for the drop-off table and tool station locations. Are you bringing anything in, or do you know of anyone who needs carry-help?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Maybe, but before I send anyone over, can you confirm in writing what repairs are actually approved and who’s officially collecting any money or parts?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have that confirmed yet — I’m still waiting on Faye for the logistics details. I’ll check on the approved repairs and who’s collecting money or parts, then send you the written info.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Vik, I’m still piecing together what the repair drive needs—do you know if you’re helping with supplies, setup, or repairs?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m mostly helping spread the word, Rey — telling folks to bring small appliances, bikes, clothing, simple electronics, and any tools they can, while I wait on Hana’s confirmed date and place.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — that helps. I’ll note that you’re on outreach, and I’ll check with Hana or the others about the confirmed date and place before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, I’m pretty slammed, but I’m already spreading the word to handy folks—what’s the one thing you need from me next?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — if you can keep spreading the word and send any handy folks my way, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do—I’ll keep nudging the handy folks I know and point them your way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Noah, before I tell anyone to help with the repair drive, can you confirm in writing what’s being repaired and whether the treasurer is officially collecting any money or parts?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can write down what I remember: faucet, porch step, and hallway light, with maybe a fourth we still need to verify. I haven’t heard anything official about the treasurer collecting money or parts, so please don’t announce that until Hana or Mara confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Noah — that helps, but I’m going to wait for Hana or Mara to confirm the full repair list and who’s handling money or parts before I point anyone your way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ll start by checking with the building office today about the room, fees, and whether repairs are allowed there, but let’s not announce anything until we have the repair list, treasurer confirmation, and tool inventory in writing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll keep tracking the repair list and setup spots, and we can hold off on announcing until those confirmations are in writing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal—once I hear back from the building office, I’ll share the dates, fees, and room rules so we can match them against your repair list before committing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Sam, I’m catching up on the repair drive while I’m out — do you know who’s officially coordinating the repairs and collecting any parts or money?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure who’s officially coordinating that part, Ira. I can check in and let you know who’s handling the repairs and collection.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Sam — that’d help a lot. I’ll hold off sending anyone your way until we know who’s officially handling repairs and any parts or money.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Rosa, I’m tracking supplies for the repair drive—could you bring any spare batteries or screws if you have them?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Cleo — I’ll bring the spare batteries and screws I have, and I’ll make sure they get to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I really appreciate it. Batteries and screws are exactly what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Quinn — before we move anything forward, can you tell me what you’ve heard about the repair drive date, place, and priority repairs?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I haven’t got the final date or place yet, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I do — the early priority sounds like porch lights and loose handrails.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll hold off until the date and place are confirmed, and I’ll note porch lights and loose handrails as the current priorities.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Gus, I’m still getting most of my updates second-hand, but it sounds like porch lights and loose handrails are the big repair drive priorities so far. Have you heard of anyone who might need help carrying things over?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven’t heard a specific name yet, Nell, but I can swing by early Saturday with my hand truck and help carry tools or parts wherever they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be a huge help, Gus — thank you. I’ll pass along that you’re available early Saturday with the hand truck.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli, we’re getting the repair drive pieces lined up now — focusing on small appliances, bikes, clothing, and simple electronics while we wait on Hana to confirm the date and location.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds sensible, Jules — those categories are clear enough for folks to understand. Once Hana confirms the date and location, I’ll share the details and start keeping a proper list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Eli — having you keep the list will really help. I’ll keep checking on repair volunteers and send you names as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Leo! I’m collecting the latest on the repair drive so I can keep everyone straight—Oren says he’s aiming to start around 3:30 and bring duct tape, maybe a flashlight, and screws if he finds them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, thanks. Tell Oren 3:30 works, and have him bring the screws if he finds them—we still need small fasteners.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, I’ll pass that along to Oren—3:30 is good, and I’ll nudge him hard about checking that junk drawer for screws.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — 3:30 works well for the school pickup crowd. I’ll let the other parents know and ask Noah to be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye—that’s a big help. I’ll aim for 3:30 and try not to forget the duct tape, flashlight, and those spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — I’ll tell Noah to be there around 3:30 and mention those supplies in case anyone can bring extras.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina — for the repair drive, Noah’s on donated tools and Bo and Rey are covering greetings, so could you help with setting up the tables around 9?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I can help set up tables at 9. Do we have the room confirmed yet, or are we still waiting on Pia before locking that in?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Mina — I’ll put you down for tables at 9, and yes, we’re still waiting on Pia to confirm the room before I call it fully locked in.
